content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a member of the Executive Board position at the European Central Bank. Tell about your experience in strategic monetary policy guidance, financial system stability supervision, and international economic diplomacy. Also describe how you have influenced euro area economic policy and promoted the development of the monetary union. Length about 400 words.
